tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, Spring & API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Tech Lead position at your organization. With over five years of dedicated enterprise e-commerce experience building and scaling robust platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in complex architecture, backend services, and headless API integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented comprehensive backend and frontend functionality on enterprise platforms using Java and Spring, adhering to rigorous design patterns and platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, building custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized high-performance data pipelines and data synchronization mechanisms across global e-commerce channels, ERP, and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production troubleshooting, and provided technical guidance to engineering teams while collaborating with international business and technical stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with your technical leadership needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering experience to your team to help drive robust architecture and scalable platform development. Your focus on advanced commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my background in building high-performance Java and API-driven architectures at global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture and API integration expertise to drive robust technical delivery for your platform.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Ms Kour, I am a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years building enterprise platforms and headless APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I would love to discuss how my architecture and integration expertise can support your team as a Tech Lead. CV attached!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Kour,

I am writing to apply for the Tech Lead position. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce development, robust API integration, and architecture experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your engineering team.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached to this email. I hold a valid German work permit, am serving my notice period until 15.12.2026, and can start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
